fact: Zalthir rolls a 24 on a stealth check.
source_quote: Zalthir rolled a 24
subject: Zalthir

fact: The party fails the DC 14 stealth check despite the darkness granting advantage.
source_quote: the group as a whole missed the DC 14 check
subject: stealth failure

fact: Thorin rolls normally for stealth despite his armor normally imposing disadvantage.
source_quote: Thorin still rolls normally, since his armor normally imposes disadvantage
subject: Thorin

fact: Gyrgum claims his stealth check is his cleverest and most secret technique.
source_quote: This is my cleverest and most secret technique, my stealth check
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The visible Derro assassin states that the Derro Council sent Gray Ghosts to exact revenge for the deaths of their High Council members.
source_quote: He declared that the Derro Council had sent its Gray Ghosts to exact revenge for the deaths of their High Council members
subject: Derro assassin

fact: The visible Derro assassin claims the derro know exactly who the party is.
source_quote: We know who it is, even if the rest of this city doesn't know who it is
subject: Derro assassin

fact: The visible Derro assassin admits they might have misdirected others to ensure they get their revenge.
source_quote: And maybe we told them it looked like that so that we would get our revenge
subject: Derro assassin

fact: The Derro Council sent Gray Ghosts to exact revenge for the deaths of their High Council members.
source_quote: He declared that the Derro Council had sent its Gray Ghosts to exact revenge for the deaths of their High Council members
subject: Derro Council

fact: The Gray Ghosts are Derro assassins sent to cause chaos.
source_quote: a bunch of gray ghosts, assassins who've been sent out to try to cause chaos
subject: Gray Ghosts

fact: Invisible figures close in on the party from all sides as the leader speaks.
source_quote: Before the words had fully left his mouth, invisible figures closed in from all sides
subject: ambush begins

fact: There are five Derro assassins in total.
source_quote: There are five derro in total, four of them invisible
subject: Derro assassin

fact: Four of the Derro assassins are invisible, imposing disadvantage on attacks against them.
source_quote: four of them invisible, which imposes disadvantage on attacks against them
subject: Invisible Derro assassin

fact: Zalthir cuts down the visible leader of the Derro assassins.
source_quote: Zalthir moved with lethal speed, cutting down the visible leader
subject: Zalthir kills leader

fact: Zalthir cuts down a second hidden Derro attacker before they could react.
source_quote: cutting down the visible leader and a second hidden attacker before they could react
subject: Zalthir kills hidden attacker

fact: Gyrgum casts the newly learned Spirit Guardians spell.
source_quote: Gyrgum called upon the power of his faith, casting the newly learned Spirit Guardians
subject: Spirit Guardians cast

fact: Spectral angelic guardians erupt around Gyrgum, tearing through two more assassins.
source_quote: A swarm of spectral, angelic guardians erupted around him, tearing through two more assassins
subject: Spirit Guardians effect

fact: The first Derro killed by Spirit Guardians fails its Wisdom save and takes 17 damage.
source_quote: The first derro fails its Wisdom save and takes 17 damage
subject: Derro assassin

fact: The second Derro killed by Spirit Guardians moves into the emanation, fails its save, and takes 15 damage.
source_quote: It fails its save (DC 15, derro at −3) and takes 15 damage
subject: Derro assassin

fact: Thorin finishes the last Derro attacker with a decisive two-attack sequence.
source_quote: Thorin finished the last of them with a decisive two-attack sequence
subject: Thorin kills final attacker

fact: Thorin hits the final attacker for 8 damage.
source_quote: He hits for 8, then kills with his new second attack
subject: Thorin damage roll

fact: All five Derro assassins are dead.
source_quote: All five Derro lay dead
subject: Derro defeated

fact: Daz whistles while the party searches the fallen Derro.
source_quote: Daz whistled while they searched
subject: Daz

fact: Daz's whistling is a nod to Whistler, a character from a past campaign who always searched bodies.
source_quote: Whistler would always search all bodies
subject: Whistler

fact: The party finds a fuzzy lucky foot of indeterminate origin on one of the bodies.
source_quote: a fuzzy lucky foot of indeterminate origin
subject: lucky foot

fact: Gyrgum claims the lucky foot.
source_quote: Gyrgum claimed
subject: Gyrgum takes lucky foot

fact: Gyrgum states he can always use the lucky foot.
source_quote: I'm claiming the lucky foot. I can always use that
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The party finds a handful of coins on the fallen Derro.
source_quote: They found a handful of coins
subject: coins

fact: One body carried 3 gp and 8 sp.
source_quote: One body carried 3 gp and 8 sp
subject: coin pouch 1

fact: One body carried 10 cp.
source_quote: another 10 cp
subject: coin pouch 2

fact: One body carried 12 sp.
source_quote: a third 12 sp
subject: coin pouch 3

fact: The party finds a letter bearing the seal of the Council of Savants.
source_quote: they found a letter bearing the seal of the Council of Savants
subject: letter

fact: The Council of Savants ordered the Gray Ghosts to strike down the Duergar who brought the Ember Vanguard into the city.
source_quote: The letter ordered the Gray Ghosts to strike down the Duergar who had brought the Ember Vanguard into the city
subject: Council of Savants

fact: The Ember Vanguard was brought into the city by the Duergar.
source_quote: the Duergar who had brought the Ember Vanguard into the city
subject: Ember Vanguard

fact: Thorin concludes the Ember Vanguard is now enemy number one.
source_quote: Thorin concludes the Ember Vanguard is now "enemy number one"
subject: Ember Vanguard status change

fact: The decision on whether to leave, hide, or stage the Derro bodies is left open for the next session.
source_quote: Whether to leave the bodies, hide them, or stage them is left open for next session
subject: body disposal

fact: The party attempts to slip away toward the Darklake District.
source_quote: slip away toward the Darklake District
subject: Darklake District

fact: Gracklstugh has a web of political conspiracy festering beneath its streets.
source_quote: laying bare the web of political conspiracy festering beneath Gracklstugh's streets
subject: Gracklstugh
